Ester or amide carbonyls (candidates 3, 5, 6, 9) would appear higher (≈1740 cm⁻¹) or lower (≈1650 cm⁻¹), respectively.  
The pair of medium-strong bands at 745 and 762 cm⁻¹ together with the CH₃ deformation at 1454 cm⁻¹ are characteristic of the tert-butyl (t-C(CH₃)₃) group; pinacolone (candidate 1) contains such a tert-butyl group directly attached to the carbonyl carbon.  
No bands typical of C–O–C stretching of ethers/esters (~1050–1150 cm⁻¹) are observed, disfavouring the methoxy and ester candidates (2–3, 5).
